name: Toastea Rusk
ingredients_raw: Refined wheat flour (Maida) (71%), Sugar, Refined palm and palmolein oil, Semolina (Suji) (1.8%), Yeast, Vital gluten, Colour (150a), Invert sugar syrup, Iodised salt, Emulsifiers (472e, 471), Spice (0.3%) (Green cardamom seeds), Bread improver {Starch, Soya flour, Improvers [1100(i), 1104, 1102]}, Wheat fiber, Nature identical & artificial (milk) flavouring substances and antioxidant (300). Contains wheat gluten and soya.
